label: Indispensable means support the NECESSITATE_5 giving application
note: The source concerns necessity of willing a means arising from willing its end. It also recognizes necessity on the distinct supposition that God wills a creature. The premise concerns fixity of giving esse across accessible worlds where the giver exists, for any rational power meeting the antecedent. It needs a bridge from cross-world giving to willing of this effect necessitated by willing the same end.
